items.title: Moves to axe character references after Western Power rape case

children.content: There are growing calls for the WA government to ban positive character evidence after three Western Power staff were stood down for offering references to a former colleague convicted of rape.

items.title: Binders can be 'life-changing' for trans people. But are they safe to exercise in?

children.content: Binders are popular among trans and gender diverse people, but research is yet to show if they're safe to exercise in. A university has led the largest study so far in the search for answers, and the preliminary results are promising.
